import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Fix island label variants (strip spaces)
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric (handle commas)
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    
    # Convert flipper_length_mm to numeric (already numeric but had negative values)
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'])
    
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    
    # Filter out invalid body_mass_g values (out of range: 2500-6500)
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    
    # Filter out negative flipper_length_mm values
    df = df[df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 0]
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Group by sex and compute average body mass
    result = df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return result
